industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: Absolute Clean Energy Public Company Limited
summary: Absolute Clean Energy Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates biomass, municipal solid waste, natural gas, and solar energy power plants in Thailand. The company operates through four segments: Biomass Power Plants, Solid Waste Power Plant, Natural Gas Power Plant, and Solar Energy Power Plant. As of December 31, 2020, it has 19 power plants with an installed capacity of 245.91 megawatts. The company was founded in 2015 and is headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand.
